svg.text: The core loop
Every 10 seconds a fair move, every minute a crystal freed, every 10 minutes a hall lit, across days the temple's wings
10 s: a fair move
one off each pan
1 min: a crystal freed
10 min: a hall lit
days: the temple's wings
one fair move with the hands: the same
off both pans, shared out, or put on
both; the altar answers at once (a
chime, the chains glow; or they rattle
and it springs back)
1 min
one altar: the crystal freed, its
Glimmer wakes and sings, the gems count
its weight aloud, the rune line shows it
10 min
one hall: the chandelier fills, the
Glimmers sing their tune together, the
great door opens onto the next room
days
a wing a grade: the Recipe Kitchen (5),
the Hall and the Sky Room (6), the
Mirror Halls (7), the Twin Altars and
the Star Floor (8); your own altar for a
friend (phase D)
Never timed, never lost: an altar waits as long as the child thinks; a refused move changes nothing.
